description: This file defines the ReportToAccessStrategy class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system's maintenance access strategies. The class provides an 'access' method that retrieves record data associated with an employee's subordinates and supervisors, likely to determine access permissions based on reporting relationships.
external_files: # Assumed to be a parent class or related to access strategy implementations, located in the same namespace or directory.

classes.name: ReportToAccessStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing an access strategy based on employee reporting relationships within the HRM system.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Retrieves access data related to the employee's subordinates and supervisors, returning an array of associated records.
